//go:build js && wasm && !nextgo_module

package client

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"syscall/js"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type offlineDisableFixture struct {
	x                *offlineRealmFixture
	stats            js.Value
	unregisters      int
	onRequest        func(offlineRequest)
	unregister       func() js.Value
	expectQuarantine bool
}

// These explicitly native-shaped events are bounded unit fakes. They do not
// attest that an installed browser generated a trusted event or retired a job.
func freshOfflineDisableFixture(t *testing.T) *offlineDisableFixture {
	t.Helper()
	x := freshOfflineRealmFixture(t)
	x.childWin.Set("Promise", js.Global().Get("Promise"))
	x.childWin.Set("Reflect", js.Global().Get("Reflect"))
	d := &offlineDisableFixture{x: x, stats: x.f.channels}
	d.stats.Set("channels", js.Global().Get("Array").New())
	channel := js.Global().Get("Function").New("stats", `return class {
 constructor(){
  stats.created++; let callback;
  const p1={_closed:false,addEventListener(type,fn,options){if(options&&options.once)stats.once=(stats.once||0)+1;callback=fn;stats.listeners++},removeEventListener(){if(callback){callback=undefined;stats.listeners--}},start(){},close(){if(stats.closeFail)throw new Error('close failed');if(!this._closed){this._closed=true;stats.closed++}}};
  const emit=(data,trusted=true,target=p1)=>{if(callback)callback({data,isTrusted:trusted,target})};
  const p2={_closed:false,emit,postMessage(data){stats.last=p2;stats.data=data;if(stats.hold)return;if(stats.badFirst){emit({...data,requestID:'wrong'});emit(data,false);emit(data,true,{});}emit(data);if(stats.duplicate)emit(data);},close(){if(stats.closeFail)throw new Error('close failed');if(!this._closed){this._closed=true;stats.closed++}}};
  this.port1=p1;this.port2=p2;stats.channels.push(this);if(stats.onConstruct)stats.onConstruct();
  if(stats.constructThrow)throw new Error('after construction');
 }
}`).Invoke(d.stats)
	win.Set("MessageChannel", channel)
	original := x.f.respond
	x.f.respond = func(request offlineRequest) offlineReply {
		x.trace = append(x.trace, request.Command)
		if d.onRequest != nil {
			d.onRequest(request)
		}
		reply := original(request)
		if request.Command == "disable-recovered" {
			reply.State, reply.Enabled, reply.DeferredCleanup = "disabled", false, true
			reply.ActiveGeneration = strings.Repeat("d", 64)
		}
		return reply
	}
	x.candidate.Set("unregister", x.f.fn(func(this js.Value, _ []js.Value) any {
		if !this.Equal(x.candidate) || !x.frame.Get("isConnected").Bool() || offlineRealmInUse == nil || offlineRealmInUse.pending != 1 {
			t.Error("unregister was not precharged on its live exact receiver")
		}
		d.unregisters++
		x.trace = append(x.trace, "unregister")
		if d.unregister != nil {
			return d.unregister()
		}
		x.childEntries, x.parentEntries = nil, nil
		return x.f.resolve(true)
	}))
 // Re-snapshot this explicitly TESTONLY platform after its native-model
 // channel/method setup, before roots install authored getter overrides.
 x.f.native.remember(win,x.candidate)
 x.f.native.observerState(d.stats)
 t.Cleanup(func(){
  if offlineRealmInUse==nil{return}
  if !d.expectQuarantine {t.Error("unexpected fresh Disable quarantine")}
  d.stats.Set("closeFail",false)
  // Revoke deliveries before marking a synthetic terminal and releasing funcs.
  x.f.native.contain(t,offlineRealmInUse)
  channels:=d.stats.Get("channels")
  for i:=0;i<channels.Length();i++{channels.Index(i).Get("port1").Call("close");channels.Index(i).Get("port2").Call("close")}
 })
	return d
}

func (d *offlineDisableFixture) fresh(ctx context.Context) (offlineFreshDisableResult, error) {
 // Direct unit helper admission only. Public operations continue to admit
 // through production offlineOperation; base fixtures remain busy=false.
 c:=d.x.f.c
 offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
 if offlineRealmInUse!=nil || c.busy {offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock();return offlineFreshDisableResult{},ErrOfflineBusy}
 c.busy=true
 c.diag=offlineDiagnosticBeginLocked(c.diag,OfflineDiagnosticDisable,c.descriptor.RuntimeID,c.descriptor.ConfigurationID)
 offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
 defer func(){offlineAuthorityMu.Lock();c.busy=false;offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()}()
 return c.disableInFreshRealm(ctx,d.x.f.sw,d.x.f.worker)
}

func offlineDisableWait(t *testing.T, done <-chan struct{}, label string) {
	t.Helper()
	select {
	case <-done:
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal(label)
	}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableUsesOneCommandAndExactLiveNativeUnregister(t *testing.T) {
	d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
	d.x.childSW.Set("controller", js.Null())
	d.stats.Set("badFirst", true)
	d.stats.Set("duplicate", true)
	checkReadCharge := func() {
		if offlineRealmInUse == nil || offlineRealmInUse.pending != 1 || len(offlineRealmInUse.disableNative) != 1 {
			t.Error("fresh read was not precharged before delivery")
		}
	}
	d.x.beforeChildRead, d.x.beforeLookup = checkReadCharge, checkReadCharge
	d.x.reply = func(label string, value js.Value) js.Value {
		if label == "parent-list" {
			checkReadCharge()
		}
		return value
	}
	d.x.afterRemove = func() {
		if offlineRealmInUse == nil || offlineRealmInUse.disableObserver.valid || !offlineRealmInUse.disableObserver.then.IsUndefined() || !offlineRealmInUse.disableObserver.apply.IsUndefined() || len(offlineRealmInUse.disableNative) != 1 || offlineRealmInUse.pending != 1 || offlineRealmInUse.disableNative[0].operation != offlineNativeRetireLive || len(offlineRealmInUse.disableReplies) != 0 {
			t.Error("child observer or native cell escaped frame retirement")
		}
		// Every child-global access after removal becomes an actual throwing
		// host getter; the final inventory must use only live parent objects.
		poison := js.Global().Get("Function").New("throw new Error('child used after removal')")
		js.Global().Get("Object").Call("defineProperty", d.x.childWin, "navigator", map[string]any{"get": poison, "configurable": true})
	}
	result, err := d.fresh(context.Background())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !result.disableAcknowledged || !result.unregisterAttempted || !result.unregisterResolvedTrue || !result.verifiedRegistryAbsent {
		t.Fatalf("incomplete receipts: %+v", result)
	}
	if len(d.x.f.commands) != 2 || d.x.f.commands[0].Command != "status" || d.x.f.commands[1].Command != "disable-recovered" || d.unregisters != 1 || d.x.updates != 0 || d.x.f.registers != 0 || d.x.f.unregisters != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("replayed or wrong-realm command: %+v", d.x.f.commands)
	}
	if d.x.removed != 1 || offlineRealmInUse != nil || !d.x.f.sw.Get("controller").Equal(d.x.f.worker) {
		t.Fatal("completion lost parent controller or exact frame cleanup")
	}
	if !d.stats.Get("once").IsUndefined() {
		t.Fatal("invalid ACK could consume a once listener")
	}
	if !result.status.DeferredCleanup || result.status.ActiveGeneration == "" {
		t.Fatal("unregister fabricated physical cache erasure")
	}
	d.x.f.balanced(t)
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableUnknownAndRefusedRepliesNeverUnregister(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"capacity", "unsupported", "busy", "failed", "enabled"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
			previous := d.x.f.respond
			d.x.f.respond = func(request offlineRequest) offlineReply {
				reply := previous(request)
				if request.Command == "disable-recovered" {
					switch mode {
					case "capacity":
						reply.Error = "client-capacity"
					case "unsupported":
						reply.Supported = false
					case "busy":
						reply.State = "busy"
					case "failed":
						reply.State = "failed"
					case "enabled":
						reply.State, reply.Enabled = "ready", true
					}
				}
				return reply
			}
			result, err := d.fresh(context.Background())
			if err == nil || result.disableAcknowledged || result.unregisterAttempted || d.unregisters != 0 || d.x.removed != 1 || offlineRealmInUse != nil {
				t.Fatalf("refusal became disable/unregister authority: %+v %v", result, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableLateOwnedReplyJoinsBeforeRetirement(t *testing.T) {
	for _, phase := range []string{"status", "disable-recovered"} {
		t.Run(phase, func(t *testing.T) {
			d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
			started := make(chan struct{}, 1)
			d.onRequest = func(request offlineRequest) {
				if request.Command == phase {
					d.stats.Set("hold", true)
					started <- struct{}{}
				}
			}
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			type outcome struct {
				result offlineFreshDisableResult
				err    error
			}
			done := make(chan outcome, 1)
			joined := false
			defer func() {
				cancel()
				if !joined {
					if d.stats.Get("last").Truthy() {
						d.stats.Get("last").Call("emit", d.stats.Get("data"))
					}
					select {
					case <-done:
					case <-time.After(time.Second):
						t.Error("fixture could not join owned reply")
					}
				}
			}()
			go func() { result, err := d.fresh(ctx); done <- outcome{result, err} }()
			offlineDisableWait(t, started, "owned reply was not dispatched")
			cancel()
			if err := DisableOffline(context.Background()); !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineBusy) {
				t.Fatal("logical cancel admitted another frame", err)
			}
			select {
			case <-done:
				t.Fatal("cancellation abandoned owned RPC")
			default:
			}
			if offlineRealmInUse == nil || offlineRealmInUse.pending != 1 || d.x.removed != 0 || !d.x.frame.Get("isConnected").Bool() {
				t.Fatal("pending reply lost physical ownership")
			}
			d.stats.Get("last").Call("emit", d.stats.Get("data"))
			select {
			case got := <-done:
				joined = true
				if !errors.Is(got.err, ErrOfflineUnknown) || got.result.disableAcknowledged != (phase == "disable-recovered") || got.result.unregisterAttempted || d.unregisters != 0 {
					t.Fatalf("late receipt was erased or used for new mutation: %+v %v", got.result, got.err)
				}
			case <-time.After(time.Second):
				t.Fatal("exact terminal reply did not join canceled operation")
			}
			if offlineRealmInUse != nil || d.x.removed != 1 {
				t.Fatal("actual terminal reply did not permit checked cleanup")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableUnregisterTerminalTruthSurvivesCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, terminal := range []string{"true", "false", "reject"} {
		t.Run(terminal, func(t *testing.T) {
			d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
			var resolve, reject js.Value
			pending := js.Global().Get("Promise").New(d.x.f.fn(func(_ js.Value, args []js.Value) any { resolve, reject = args[0], args[1]; return nil }))
			started := make(chan struct{}, 1)
			d.unregister = func() js.Value { started <- struct{}{}; return pending }
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			type outcome struct {
				result offlineFreshDisableResult
				err    error
			}
			done := make(chan outcome, 1)
			joined := false
			defer func() {
				cancel()
				if !joined {
					resolve.Invoke(false)
					select {
					case <-done:
					case <-time.After(time.Second):
						t.Error("fixture could not join native unregister")
					}
				}
			}()
			go func() { result, err := d.fresh(ctx); done <- outcome{result, err} }()
			offlineDisableWait(t, started, "unregister did not start")
			cancel()
			select {
			case <-done:
				t.Fatal("cancellation abandoned native unregister")
			default:
			}
			if offlineRealmInUse == nil || offlineRealmInUse.pending != 1 || d.x.removed != 0 {
				t.Fatal("native pending charge was lost")
			}
			if terminal == "reject" {
				reject.Invoke("native refusal")
			} else {
				resolve.Invoke(terminal == "true")
			}
			select {
			case got := <-done:
				joined = true
				if !errors.Is(got.err, ErrOfflineUnknown) || !got.result.disableAcknowledged || !got.result.unregisterAttempted || got.result.unregisterResolvedTrue != (terminal == "true") || got.result.verifiedRegistryAbsent {
					t.Fatalf("native truth conflated with logical cancellation: %+v %v", got.result, got.err)
				}
			case <-time.After(time.Second):
				t.Fatal("native unregister terminal did not join")
			}
			if d.unregisters != 1 || offlineRealmInUse != nil || d.x.removed != 1 {
				t.Fatal("native terminal retried or failed checked retirement")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisablePromiseObserverBypassesAuthoredThen(t *testing.T) {
	d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
	authored := false
	d.unregister = func() js.Value {
		d.x.childEntries, d.x.parentEntries = nil, nil
		promise := d.x.f.resolve(true)
		promise.Set("then", d.x.f.fn(func(js.Value, []js.Value) any { authored = true; return nil }))
		return promise
	}
	result, err := d.fresh(context.Background())
	if err != nil || authored || !result.unregisterResolvedTrue || !result.verifiedRegistryAbsent {
		t.Fatalf("observer trusted an instance then: %+v %v", result, err)
	}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableCapturedObserverIgnoresLaterChildGlobalReplacement(t *testing.T) {
	d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
	nativeThen := js.Global().Get("Promise").Get("prototype").Get("then")
	constructor := js.Global().Get("Function").New("return function InitialChildPromise(){}").Invoke()
	constructor.Get("prototype").Set("then", nativeThen)
	d.x.childWin.Set("Promise", constructor)
	fakeCalls, changed := 0, false
	fake := d.x.f.fn(func(js.Value, []js.Value) any { fakeCalls++; return nil })
	d.x.beforeChildRead = func() {
		if changed {
			return
		}
		changed = true
  // This hook runs during the first model child invocation. V3 observes
  // through startup-captured parent primitives; no child global is consulted.
		constructor.Get("prototype").Set("then", fake)
		replacement := js.Global().Get("Function").New("return function ReplacementChildPromise(){}").Invoke()
		replacement.Get("prototype").Set("then", fake)
		d.x.childWin.Set("Promise", replacement)
		d.x.childWin.Set("Reflect", map[string]any{"apply": fake})
	}
	result, err := d.fresh(context.Background())
	if err != nil || !changed || fakeCalls != 0 || !result.disableAcknowledged || !result.unregisterResolvedTrue || !result.verifiedRegistryAbsent || d.unregisters != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("native observer was looked up again from mutable child globals: %+v %v, fake=%d", result, err, fakeCalls)
	}
}

func TestOfflineRecoveredDisableRefusalPublishesOnlyNewestConfirmedPreStatus(t *testing.T) {
	d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
	d.x.f.c.state.Enabled, d.x.f.c.state.ActiveGeneration, d.x.f.c.confirmedDisabled = false, strings.Repeat("a", 64), true
	previous := d.x.f.respond
	d.x.f.respond = func(request offlineRequest) offlineReply {
		reply := previous(request)
		if request.Command == "disable-recovered" {
			reply.Error = "client-capacity"
		}
		return reply
	}
	if err := DisableOffline(context.Background()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("capacity refusal reported success")
	}
	state := OfflineStatus()
	if !state.Enabled || state.ActiveGeneration != strings.Repeat("d", 64) || d.x.f.c.confirmedDisabled || !offlineNativeNavigation() || d.x.f.c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged || d.unregisters != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("refused control replaced newest confirmed pre-status with default false or stale state: %+v", state)
	}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableLateObserverThrowReceiptStaysPrivateAndQuarantined(t *testing.T) {
	d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
	d.expectQuarantine = true
	d.x.f.c.state.Enabled, d.x.f.c.state.ActiveGeneration = true, strings.Repeat("d", 64)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	var resolve js.Value
	held := js.Global().Get("Promise").New(d.x.f.fn(func(_ js.Value, args []js.Value) any { resolve = args[0]; return nil }))
 // V3 TESTONLY observer failure injection uses the installed facet primitive;
 // child Promise globals are deliberately bypassed by production capture.
 d.x.f.native.observerState(d.stats)
	d.unregister = func() js.Value { d.stats.Set("observerThrow", true); cancel(); return held }
	old := documentOffline
	if err := DisableOffline(ctx); !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineUnknown) {
		t.Fatal("throwing observer reported a known complete operation", err)
	}
	if !old.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged || !old.lastDisable.unregisterAttempted || old.lastDisable.unregisterResolvedTrue || old.lastDisable.verifiedRegistryAbsent || !old.state.Enabled || old.confirmedDisabled {
		t.Fatal("pre-terminal outcome was erased or published as current disabled state")
	}
	lease := offlineRealmInUse
	if lease == nil || lease.pending != 1 || len(lease.disableNative) != 1 || d.x.removed != 0 {
		t.Fatal("unknown attached observer lost its physical quarantine")
	}
	cell := lease.disableNative[0]
	oldState := old.state
	replacement := *old
	replacement.busy = false
	replacement.state.Phase, replacement.state.LastError = "ready", ""
	replacement.lastDisable = offlineDisableReceipt{}
	documentOffline = &replacement
	defer func() { documentOffline = old }()
	newState := replacement.state
	observed := 0
	scope := &Scope{}
	defer scope.dispose()
	if err := SubscribeOffline(scope, func(OfflineState) { observed++ }); err != nil || observed != 1 {
		t.Fatal("replacement observer setup failed", err)
	}
	if err := DisableOffline(context.Background()); !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineBusy) {
		t.Fatal("replacement bypassed unknown observer quarantine", err)
	}
	resolve.Invoke(true)
	if !cell.terminal {
		offlineDisableWait(t, cell.done, "late native observer did not return")
	}
	if !cell.terminal || !cell.charged || !old.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged || !old.lastDisable.unregisterAttempted || !old.lastDisable.unregisterResolvedTrue || old.lastDisable.verifiedRegistryAbsent {
		t.Fatal("late native true did not become exact old-operation private knowledge")
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(old.state, oldState) || !reflect.DeepEqual(replacement.state, newState) || replacement.lastDisable != (offlineDisableReceipt{}) || observed != 1 || old.confirmedDisabled || replacement.confirmedDisabled {
		t.Fatal("late private settlement published stale state or notified replacement observers")
	}
	if offlineRealmInUse != lease || lease.pending != 1 || d.x.removed != 0 || !d.x.frame.Get("isConnected").Bool() || !errors.Is(lease.close(), ErrOfflineUnknown) || d.unregisters != 1 {
		t.Fatal("late terminal incorrectly cleared unknown observer attachment or replayed unregister")
	}
}

func TestOfflineRecoveredDisablePartialCommitPreservesPublicKnowledge(t *testing.T) {
	for _, terminal := range []string{"false", "rejected"} {
		t.Run(terminal, func(t *testing.T) {
			d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
			d.x.f.c.state.Enabled, d.x.f.c.state.ActiveGeneration = true, strings.Repeat("d", 64)
			d.unregister = func() js.Value {
				if terminal == "rejected" {
					return js.Global().Get("Promise").Call("reject", "native refused")
				}
				return d.x.f.resolve(false)
			}
			if err := DisableOffline(context.Background()); !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineUnknown) {
				t.Fatal("partial unregister reported full success", err)
			}
			state := OfflineStatus()
			if state.Enabled || !state.CleanupPending || state.ActiveGeneration == "" || !d.x.f.c.confirmedDisabled || offlineNativeNavigation() {
				t.Fatalf("known disable receipt was rolled back or invented erasure: %+v", state)
			}
			if !d.x.f.c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged || !d.x.f.c.lastDisable.unregisterAttempted || d.x.f.c.lastDisable.unregisterResolvedTrue || d.x.f.c.lastDisable.verifiedRegistryAbsent || d.unregisters != 1 {
				t.Fatal("partial native outcome was conflated with successful cleanup")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestOfflineRecoveredDisableCanceledLateACKIsPrivateToOldController(t *testing.T) {
	d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
	d.x.f.c.state.Enabled = true
	started := make(chan struct{}, 1)
	d.onRequest = func(request offlineRequest) {
		if request.Command == "disable-recovered" {
			d.stats.Set("hold", true)
			started <- struct{}{}
		}
	}
	old := documentOffline
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	joined := false
	defer func() {
		cancel()
		if !joined {
			if d.stats.Get("last").Truthy() {
				d.stats.Get("last").Call("emit", d.stats.Get("data"))
			}
			select {
			case <-done:
			case <-time.After(time.Second):
				t.Error("old controller reply did not join")
			}
		}
		documentOffline = old
	}()
	go func() { done <- DisableOffline(ctx) }()
	offlineDisableWait(t, started, "recovered command did not dispatch")
	replacement := *old
	replacement.busy = false
	replacement.state.Phase, replacement.state.LastError = "ready", ""
	documentOffline = &replacement
	cancel()
	if err := DisableOffline(context.Background()); !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineBusy) {
		t.Fatal("replacement bypassed old physical lease", err)
	}
	d.stats.Get("last").Call("emit", d.stats.Get("data"))
	select {
	case err := <-done:
		joined = true
		if !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineUnknown) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("late old ACK did not join")
	}
	if !old.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged || old.lastDisable.unregisterAttempted || !old.state.Enabled || old.confirmedDisabled {
		t.Fatal("late old receipt was erased or published without authority")
	}
	if replacement.state.Phase != "ready" || replacement.state.LastError != "" || !replacement.state.Enabled || replacement.confirmedDisabled || d.unregisters != 0 || offlineRealmInUse != nil {
		t.Fatal("late old operation changed replacement state or issued unregister")
	}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableRechecksCandidateAfterPortSetup(t *testing.T) {
	d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
 d.expectQuarantine=true
	d.stats.Set("onConstruct", d.x.f.fn(func(js.Value, []js.Value) any {
		if d.stats.Get("created").Int() == 2 {
			d.x.candidate.Set("active", js.Null())
		}
		return nil
	}))
	result, err := d.fresh(context.Background())
	if err == nil || result.disableAcknowledged || result.unregisterAttempted || len(d.x.f.commands) != 1 || d.x.f.commands[0].Command != "status" || d.unregisters != 0 || offlineRealmInUse == nil || !offlineRealmInUse.quarantined || d.x.removed != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("stale candidate survived port setup: %+v %v", result, err)
	}
 if _,next:=d.fresh(context.Background());!errors.Is(next,ErrOfflineBusy)||d.x.created!=1{t.Fatal("native candidate refusal admitted another helper",next)}
 if !errors.Is(offlineRealmInUse.close(),ErrOfflineUnknown){t.Fatal("native candidate refusal used remove-as-abort")}
}

// V3 derivative: authored method/slot accessors cannot run in the native model.
// The old final-getter revocation seam is replaced by a preparation hook below.
func TestOfflineFreshDisableMethodGetterCannotCrossFinalDispatchFence(t *testing.T) {
 for _,method:=range []string{"postMessage","unregister"}{t.Run(method,func(t *testing.T){
  d:=freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
  target:=d.x.candidate;if method=="postMessage"{target=d.x.f.worker}
  reads:=0
  getter:=d.x.f.fn(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{reads++;d.x.candidate.Set("active",js.Null());return js.Undefined()})
  js.Global().Get("Object").Call("defineProperty",target,method,map[string]any{"get":getter,"configurable":true})
  result,err:=d.fresh(context.Background())
  if err!=nil || reads!=0 || !result.disableAcknowledged || !result.unregisterAttempted || !result.unregisterResolvedTrue || !result.verifiedRegistryAbsent || d.unregisters!=1 || offlineRealmInUse!=nil || d.x.removed!=1 {
   t.Fatalf("authored method getter crossed captured model dispatch: reads=%d result=%+v error=%v",reads,result,err)
  }
  if len(d.x.f.commands)!=2 || d.x.f.commands[0].Command!="status" || d.x.f.commands[1].Command!="disable-recovered" {t.Fatal("captured dispatch changed command count or role")}
 })}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableFinalProofGetterRevocationStopsNextDestructiveInvocation(t *testing.T) {
 for _,phase:=range []string{"control","unregister"}{for _,property:=range []string{"active","scriptURL"}{for _,revoked:=range []string{"parent-controller","parent-container","parent-document","child-document","child-controller"}{
  t.Run(phase+"/"+property+"/"+revoked,func(t *testing.T){
   d:=freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
   active:=js.ValueOf(map[string]any{"scriptURL":d.x.f.c.descriptor.WorkerURL,"postMessage":d.x.f.worker.Get("postMessage"),"state":"activated"})
   d.x.candidate.Set("active",active)
   d.x.f.native.remember(d.x.candidate,active)
   target:=d.x.candidate;if property=="scriptURL"{target=active}
   getterReads,hooks:=0,0
   getter:=d.x.f.fn(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{getterReads++;return js.Undefined()})
   js.Global().Get("Object").Call("defineProperty",target,property,map[string]any{"get":getter,"configurable":true})
   originalDoc:=doc;defer func(){doc=originalDoc}()
   var lease *offlineProofRealm
   operation:=offlineNativeRPCActiveDisableRecovered;if phase=="unregister"{operation=offlineNativeUnregisterRegistration}
   d.expectQuarantine=revoked!="parent-document"
   d.x.f.native.before(d.x.f.fn(func(_ js.Value,args []js.Value)any{
    if len(args)!=2 || args[0].Int()!=int(operation){return nil}
    hooks++;lease=offlineRealmInUse
    switch revoked{
    case "parent-controller":d.x.f.sw.Set("controller",js.Null())
    case "parent-container":win.Get("navigator").Set("serviceWorker",js.ValueOf(map[string]any{"controller":d.x.f.worker}))
    case "parent-document":doc=js.ValueOf(map[string]any{})
    case "child-document":d.x.frame.Set("contentDocument",js.ValueOf(map[string]any{}))
    case "child-controller":d.x.childSW.Set("controller",js.Null())
    }
    return nil
   }).Value)
   result,err:=d.fresh(context.Background())
   wantAck,wantCommands:=phase=="unregister",1;if wantAck{wantCommands=2}
   if err==nil || hooks!=1 || getterReads!=0 {t.Fatalf("pre-entry revocation/getter bypass lost: error=%v hooks=%d getters=%d",err,hooks,getterReads)}
   if result.disableAcknowledged!=wantAck || result.unregisterAttempted || result.unregisterResolvedTrue || result.verifiedRegistryAbsent || d.unregisters!=0 {t.Fatalf("revocation dispatched or erased partial knowledge: %+v",result)}
   if wantAck && (!offlineDisableAcknowledged(result.status)||!d.x.f.c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged){t.Fatal("known successful disable ACK was lost")}
   if len(d.x.f.commands)!=wantCommands || d.x.f.commands[0].Command!="status" || wantAck&&d.x.f.commands[1].Command!="disable-recovered" || d.x.f.registers!=0 || d.x.updates!=0 || d.x.f.unregisters!=0 {t.Fatal("revocation retried or repaired native control")}
   if revoked=="parent-document"{
    if offlineRealmInUse!=nil || lease==nil || !lease.retired || lease.pending!=0 || !lease.frame.IsUndefined() || d.x.removed!=1 {t.Fatal("business ENTRY_REFUSED did not finish original physical cleanup")}
   }else{
    if offlineRealmInUse!=lease || lease==nil || !lease.quarantined || d.x.removed!=0 || !d.x.frame.Get("isConnected").Bool(){t.Fatal("V3 native identity refusal lost the original held realm")}
    if _,next:=d.fresh(context.Background());!errors.Is(next,ErrOfflineBusy)||d.x.created!=1{t.Fatal("native identity refusal admitted a replacement frame",next)}
    if !errors.Is(lease.close(),ErrOfflineUnknown){t.Fatal("native identity refusal used remove-as-abort")}
   }
  })
 }}}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableUnknownNativeDeliveryKeepsSingletonQuarantined(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"thenable", "throw-after-start", "observer-throw-after-attachment"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
			d.expectQuarantine = true
			if mode == "thenable" {
				d.unregister = func() js.Value {
					return js.ValueOf(map[string]any{"then": d.x.f.fn(func(js.Value, []js.Value) any { t.Error("authored thenable was invoked"); return nil })})
				}
			} else if mode == "throw-after-start" {
				forward := d.x.candidate.Get("unregister")
				d.x.candidate.Set("unregister", js.Global().Get("Function").New("forward", "return function(){forward.call(this);throw new Error('after start')}").Invoke(forward))
			} else {
    // Explicit TESTONLY same-observer attachment failure; no child global
    // replacement is mistaken for the captured production observer.
    d.x.f.native.observerState(d.stats)
				d.unregister = func() js.Value {
					promise := d.x.f.resolve(true)
					d.stats.Set("observerThrow", true)
					return promise
				}
			}
			result, err := d.fresh(context.Background())
			if !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineUnknown) || !result.disableAcknowledged || !result.unregisterAttempted || result.verifiedRegistryAbsent || mode != "observer-throw-after-attachment" && result.unregisterResolvedTrue || d.unregisters != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("unknown delivery fabricated completion: %+v %v", result, err)
			}
			if offlineRealmInUse == nil || offlineRealmInUse.pending != 1 || d.x.removed != 0 || len(offlineRealmInUse.disableNative) != 1 {
				t.Fatal("unknown invocation/observer discarded ownership")
			}
			if mode == "observer-throw-after-attachment" {
				cell := offlineRealmInUse.disableNative[0]
				if !cell.terminal {
					offlineDisableWait(t, cell.done, "attached native observer did not return")
				}
				if !cell.terminal || !cell.charged || offlineRealmInUse.close() == nil {
					t.Fatal("unknown attachment was silently promoted to safe retirement")
				}
			}
			if err := DisableOffline(context.Background()); !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineBusy) {
				t.Fatal("unknown native work admitted another operation", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableObservedReplacementNeverReceivesAnotherUnregister(t *testing.T) {
	for _, at := range []string{"after-disable", "after-unregister", "after-frame-removal"} {
		t.Run(at, func(t *testing.T) {
			d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
			foreign := js.ValueOf(map[string]any{"scope": d.x.f.c.descriptor.Scope, "active": map[string]any{"scriptURL": "https://reader.test/foreign.js"}})
			if at == "after-disable" {
				d.onRequest = func(request offlineRequest) {
					if request.Command == "disable-recovered" {
						d.x.childEntries = []js.Value{foreign}
					}
				}
			} else if at == "after-unregister" {
				d.unregister = func() js.Value { d.x.childEntries = []js.Value{foreign}; return d.x.f.resolve(true) }
			} else {
				d.x.afterRemove = func() { d.x.parentEntries = []js.Value{foreign} }
			}
			result, err := d.fresh(context.Background())
			wantCalls := 1
			if at == "after-disable" {
				wantCalls = 0
			}
			if err == nil || !result.disableAcknowledged || result.verifiedRegistryAbsent || d.unregisters != wantCalls || d.x.removed != 1 || offlineRealmInUse != nil {
				t.Fatalf("observed replacement was retried or hidden: %+v %v", result, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableRPCConstructorAndCloseFailuresKeepOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"constructor", "close"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
			d.expectQuarantine = true
			if mode == "constructor" {
				d.stats.Set("constructThrow", true)
			} else {
				d.stats.Set("closeFail", true)
			}
			result, err := d.fresh(context.Background())
			if !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineUnknown) || result.disableAcknowledged || d.unregisters != 0 || offlineRealmInUse == nil || offlineRealmInUse.pending != 1 || d.x.removed != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("partial RPC setup/cleanup escaped ownership: %+v %v", result, err)
			}
			if len(offlineRealmInUse.disableReplies) != 1 || d.stats.Get("closed").Int() != 0 {
				t.Fatal("partial port failure claimed a physical close")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableFirstValidReentrantReceiptWins(t *testing.T) {
	d := freshOfflineDisableFixture(t)
	previous := d.x.f.worker.Get("postMessage")
	d.x.f.worker.Set("postMessage", d.x.f.fn(func(this js.Value, args []js.Value) any {
		if args[0].Get("command").String() != "disable-recovered" {
			return previous.Call("call", this, args[0], args[1])
		}
		raw := js.Global().Get("JSON").Call("stringify", args[0]).String()
		var request offlineRequest
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &request); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return nil
		}
		d.x.f.commands = append(d.x.f.commands, request)
		reply, _ := json.Marshal(d.x.f.respond(request))
		inner := js.Global().Get("JSON").Call("parse", string(reply))
		outer := js.Global().Get("JSON").Call("parse", string(reply))
		port := args[1].Index(0)
		getter := js.Global().Get("Function").New("port", "inner", "let fired=false;return function(){if(!fired){fired=true;port.emit(inner);}return 'outer-refusal'}").Invoke(port, inner)
		js.Global().Get("Object").Call("defineProperty", outer, "error", map[string]any{"get": getter, "enumerable": true, "configurable": true})
		port.Call("emit", outer)
		return nil
	}))
	result, err := d.fresh(context.Background())
	if err != nil || !result.disableAcknowledged || !result.verifiedRegistryAbsent || d.unregisters != 1 || d.stats.Get("closed").Int() != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("outer reentry overwrote the first valid receipt: %+v %v", result, err)
	}
}
